verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list "Streaming outputs" as a feature, and the product ships an OpenAI-compatible API server, so generated outputs can be streamed back to applications. The CLI's TTFT reporting fits with incremental response delivery. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the streaming mechanism (e.g. SSE or per-token chunk format in the API), independent or hands-on corroboration of token streaming.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced

citations.quote: OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
